hooks.command: echo "Branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo none). Python: $(python --version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown). Last commit: $(git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo none)."

cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"; for danger in 'pip install' 'pip uninstall' 'python -m pip' 'uv publish' 'rm -rf /' 'DROP TABLE' 'sudo '; do if echo "$cmd" | grep -qF "$danger"; then echo "Blocked: command matches dangerous pattern '$danger'" >&2; exit 2; fi; done

file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.py ]] && [[ "$file" != */.venv/* ]] && [[ "$file" != */__pycache__/* ]]; then uv run ruff check --output-format=concise "$file" 2>/dev/null | head -20; fi

changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep '\.py$' | grep -v '.venv/'); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then uv run ruff check --fix $changed 2>/dev/null; uv run ruff format $changed 2>/dev/null; result=$(uv run mypy $changed --no-error-summary 2>&1 | tail -20); if echo "$result" | grep -q 'error:'; then echo 'Mypy errors remain — fix before considering task complete:' >&2; echo "$result" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
